times: nanoseconds represented JSON strings; integer exact
attributes: stringValue/intValue/boolValue only; duplicate keys invalid; missing=empty collection; typed canonical key
cumulative: first full interval start->time; same-start use previous valid point; restart only start>=previous end; schema/inconsistent cumulative closes that epoch until new startTime
sum: sum monotonic requires nonnegative asInt; histogram sum optional finite number; interval sum needs both baselines except first point
mixed_temporality: a single identity with mixed modes is invalid
delta_overlap: exact duplicate collapse only if identical, otherwise mark all intersecting points conflicting and exclude them
histogram: nonnegative integer bucket counts; count exact sum; bounds finite strictly increasing
output: half-open [start,end), start<end; no resampling or gap filling
